The 2024 Paris Olympics Opening Ceremony was a breathtaking event that made a significant mark on Olympic history. Athletes paraded along the Seine River on boats, which turned the entire city into a spectacular stage. The ceremony was a vibrant display of France’s diverse cultural expressions and artistic inclusion, emphasizing a message of global unity.
[[1]] On the roof of the Grand Palais, an opera singer Axelle Saint-Cirel performed “La Marseillaise,” while near the Eiffel Tower a footbridge was transformed into a catwalk for a French fashion showcase. Another opera singer, accompanied by French heavy metal band Gojira, performed “Ah! Ça ira,” a symbolic song of the French Revolution. [[2]] It not only highlighted the nation’s spirit of resilience but also symbolized France’s blend of classical heritage with contemporary evolution. Additionally, symbolic acts, such as a portrayal of Marie-Antoinette holding her head, creatively mixed historical narrative with modern art.
Artistic inclusion was another key theme, reflected through the performances of a diverse range of artists. [[3]] Lady Gaga, singing in French, added a global touch, while Aya Nakamura brought a fresh, urban energy with her dynamic performance. Celine Dion delivered a powerful rendition of Edith Piaf’s “Hymn to Love” with the Eiffel Tower in the background. Another performance featured drag queens, dancers, and models mimicking Leonardo da Vinci’s The Last Supper. The wide range of different styles and expressions demonstrated the event’s commitment to inclusivity, celebrating a broad range of artistic talents.
Overall, the 2024 Paris Olympics Opening Ceremony was an exceptional display of cultural and artistic diversity. [[4]] This event not only set a positive tone for the Games but also showcased the power of art to unite people across different cultures.

options_bank.A: A notable performance dedicated to Notre Dame’s restoration team used traditional ballet alongside modern street dance.
options_bank.B: International stars’ performances enhanced the global atmosphere and reflected the multicultural nature of the Olympics.
options_bank.C: It successfully merged traditional and modern elements, celebrating the inclusivity of French culture while embracing global artistic expressions.
options_bank.D: There were several performances highlighting cultural diversity by honoring significant French historical events and modern influences.
